privacy.ai_training_note: DataRobot explicitly states: 'When using collected data for product development, we will always remove all personal data and Customer Data.' Customer data is not directly used for model training. However, note that DataRobot's MSA prohibits SaaS customers from importing financial data, PCI data, HIPAA-regulated data, SSN, driver's license numbers, sensitive personal data under GDPR, data of minors under 16, or GLBA/COPPA-regulated data.
privacy.data_region: Global operations with US headquarters. Managed AI Cloud instance available in EU. No granular region-selection documented for standard SaaS deployment.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.3 for all API communications; DNSSEC support; option to use custom certificate authorities

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Encryption at rest available; option to use custom certificate authorities

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SAML-based SSO for enterprises; LDAP integration for Self-Managed; Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) capabilities

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC) with customizable roles and granular sharing permissions for resources and data

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Regular third-party penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities

security.name: Audits
security.value: Annual external audits and security assessments of production applications; governance, risk management, and compliance program in place

products.name: Agentic AI Platform
products.data_scope: Customer data for agent development; deployable on-premise, cloud, or hybrid
products.notes: End-to-end agent lifecycle support (build, operate, govern). Support for foundational, business (SAP co-developed), and purpose-built agents. HIPAA-compliant single-tenant SaaS available for healthcare.

products.name: Generative AI
products.data_scope: LLM and generative capabilities; supports selection of LLMs and embeddings for customer use cases
products.notes: Component of unified platform; integrated with agent and prediction workflows

products.name: Predictive AI
products.notes: Legacy product; part of unified platform but earlier generation than Agentic AI focus

products.name: AI Governance
products.data_scope: Monitoring and auditing of AI workflows; no direct customer data processing
products.notes: Compliance tracking, control definition, and automated audit documentation. Recognized in Gartner MarketScape for AI Governance.

products.name: AI Observability
products.data_scope: Agent and model quality monitoring; real-time issue detection
products.notes: Production monitoring for safe and reliable agent performance

products.name: AI Foundation
products.notes: Core infrastructure for all DataRobot products; supports multiple deployment models

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise licensing; tiers not publicly detailed. Contact sales required. Pricing 5.0 (Classic MLOps) available for some products.
compare.data_residency: Global with US headquarters. EU Managed AI Cloud available. Standard SaaS deployment does not offer granular region selection per public documentation.
